hedges.reason: None of the listed instruments carries the European energy, defense or Ukrainian bond legs of my hedge thesis. There is no TTF gas, no Rheinmetall and no Ukrainian eurobonds. The shared driver behind those legs is a Russia-Ukraine settlement, and E46 prices that driver directly. The Kremlin's stated position is that Putin will meet Zelenskyy only to sign a finished agreement. Any meeting before 2027 would therefore almost certainly be the signing or capstone of a mutually agreed halt to fighting. A ceasefire agreement by December 31 (the mildest rung) is the condition that has to hold in the worlds where 'No meeting before 2027' loses.

claims.reason: A meeting before 2027 needs the Kremlin to have dropped its refusal to meet Zelenskyy before a deal is finalized. It also needs Kyiv to accept sitting down with Putin in person. Both happen only once a ceasefire or framework agreement is agreed and announced by both sides, which is exactly what E46 counts. A leader-level meeting while active combat continues and nothing has been signed would contradict the stated positions of both governments since 2022. So a meeting before 2027 and no ceasefire agreement by December 31, 2026 should not both happen.
